groups.problem: CreateOrUpdateDevice counts devices and then inserts or updates in separate steps, so concurrent requests can push the device count past the limit.
groups.rationale: Both describe the same count-then-write race in CreateOrUpdateDevice and propose making the limit check atomic.

groups.problem: ProvideAnonDBStore now takes a deviceLimit argument, but the wire provider sets and other constructors were not updated.
groups.rationale: Both flag the same signature change breaking wire/DI providers and remaining call sites.

groups.problem: Authenticate now calls TagDevice synchronously instead of in a background goroutine, so every anonymous request blocks on database work.
groups.rationale: Both describe the switch from fire-and-forget to synchronous TagDevice in the auth hot path and suggest keeping tagging async.

groups.problem: Observation that the AnonymousDeviceLimit config value is not sensitive, whether it is read from config or sent to the frontend.
groups.rationale: All three make the same non-finding about the numeric limit value as it flows from config to the frontend DTO.

groups.problem: Observation that the new error and log paths contain no sensitive device data (ClientIP, UserAgent, DeviceID).
groups.rationale: All three confirm that the new error strings and logs do not expose device fields.
